title: Medico Marketing Excellence Executive
jobDescription:
About Astra Zeneca

Astra Zeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Introduction to role

This role drives end-to-end support to medical affairs team & VEEVA-led events, from initiation and implementation through to closure, ensuring all associated costs are accurately assembled and reconciled. It involves regular tracking and monitoring of VEEVA events for strict adherence to process and documentation standards, with timely updates shared across teams. Daily collaboration includes Medical, Marketing, as well as MME/MMSE teams, IT, Event Desk, Compliance, Sales, Business Units, Legal and other internal divisions to keep activities aligned and compliant. The role safeguards zero breaches in documentation and processes, upholds Astra Zeneca policies, and proactively raises flags where requirements or risks are identified. Ready to help develop how events are delivered with rigour and impact?

Accountabilities

Lead the full lifecycle of VEEVA-led events, ensuring accurate set-up, execution and closure in line with internal procedures and timelines.

Monitor event status and documentation on a regular basis, identifying gaps early and driving corrective actions to maintain compliance.

Coordinate closely with Medical, Marketing, MME/MMSE, Compliance, Legal, Purchase & Event Desk, Sales, IS/IT, HR and Finance to secure approvals, information and support.

Track and reconcile all event-related costs, ensuring transparency, completeness and alignment with budget expectations.

Maintain meticulous records and audit-ready documentation for all assigned events and activities.

Act as a point of contact for process queries related to VEEVA events, helping colleagues navigate systems and requirements.

Call out potential compliance issues or process deviations promptly, supporting root-cause analysis and preventive improvements.

Contribute to continuous improvement of event processes, tools and templates, leveraging IT systems for efficiency and consistency.

Support training or onboarding activities related to VEEVA event processes for relevant stakeholders.

Champion adherence to Astra Zeneca policies and standards in every interaction and decision.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Scientific background
  • Excellent project managerial skills
  • Good collaboration skills with multiple stakeholders
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English
  • MS Office Applications - should have reasonably very good command

Desirable Skills/Experience

2+ years in pharmaceutical business in commercially aware business roles is preferable

Experience of optimal use of IT systems and process improvement.

Why Astra Zeneca?

At Astra Zeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

You can find alternative messaging to use in the ‘Global Talent Attraction Story messaging’ section of the Global Playbook on the Employer Brand Portal - try to use other examples in order to make it different for candidates!

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.

Where can I find out more?

Our Social Media, Follow Astra Zeneca on Linked In https://www.linkedin.com/company/1603/

Follow Astra Zeneca on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/astrazenecacareers/

Date Posted

29-Jul-2026

Closing Date

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

description:
About Astra Zeneca

Astra Zeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Introduction to role

This role drives end-to-end support to medical affairs team & VEEVA-led events, from initiation and implementation through to closure, ensuring all associated costs are accurately assembled and reconciled. It involves regular tracking and monitoring of VEEVA events for strict adherence to process and documentation standards, with timely updates shared across teams. Daily collaboration includes Medical, Marketing, as well as MME/MMSE teams, IT, Event Desk, Compliance, Sales, Business Units, Legal and other internal divisions to keep activities aligned and compliant. The role safeguards zero breaches in documentation and processes, upholds Astra Zeneca policies, and proactively raises flags where requirements or risks are identified. Ready to help develop how events are delivered with rigour and impact?

Accountabilities

Lead the full lifecycle of VEEVA-led events, ensuring accurate set-up, execution and closure in line with internal procedures and timelines.

Monitor event status and documentation on a regular basis, identifying gaps early and driving corrective actions to maintain compliance.

Coordinate closely with Medical, Marketing, MME/MMSE, Compliance, Legal, Purchase & Event Desk, Sales, IS/IT, HR and Finance to secure approvals, information and support.

Track and reconcile all event-related costs, ensuring transparency, completeness and alignment with budget expectations.

Maintain meticulous records and audit-ready documentation for all assigned events and activities.

Act as a point of contact for process queries related to VEEVA events, helping colleagues navigate systems and requirements.

Call out potential compliance issues or process deviations promptly, supporting root-cause analysis and preventive improvements.

Contribute to continuous improvement of event processes, tools and templates, leveraging IT systems for efficiency and consistency.

Support training or onboarding activities related to VEEVA event processes for relevant stakeholders.

Champion adherence to Astra Zeneca policies and standards in every interaction and decision.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Scientific background
  • Excellent project managerial skills
  • Good collaboration skills with multiple stakeholders
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English
  • MS Office Applications - should have reasonably very good command

Desirable Skills/Experience

2+ years in pharmaceutical business in commercially aware business roles is preferable

Experience of optimal use of IT systems and process improvement.

Why Astra Zeneca?

At Astra Zeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

You can find alternative messaging to use in the ‘Global Talent Attraction Story messaging’ section of the Global Playbook on the Employer Brand Portal - try to use other examples in order to make it different for candidates!

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.

Where can I find out more?

Our Social Media, Follow Astra Zeneca on Linked In https://www.linkedin.com/company/1603/

Follow Astra Zeneca on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/astrazenecacareers/

Date Posted

29-Jul-2026

Closing Date

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. title: Lead - Diagnostics & Health Innovation Hub
jobDescription:
Typical Accountabilities

• Ensure that Diagnostic Manager and diagnostic liaison objectives are met at a national level by setting clear goals in alignment with organizational priorities.

• Develop a strategy for adoption of companion diagnostic testing, including defining metrics to measure success.

• Identify and build relationships with key scientific stakeholders such as laboratory decision makers, anatomical and molecular pathologists, and other healthcare professionals.

• Provide approved, relevant educational material on diagnostics to enhance understanding and competency among clinical laboratory leaders and their staff.

• Deliver highly technical presentations on data related to diagnostics and testing.

• Educate on the importance of diagnostic quality assurance (QA) programs to ensure high standards in testing processes.

• Partner with diagnostic companies, lab networks, and healthcare professionals to identify and resolve barriers to diagnostic testing, driving accessibility and efficiency.

• Develop tailored strategies that support and educate on appropriate diagnostic testing practices.

• Align actions with broader business plans and assess the impact of external market trends and regulatory changes on organizational strategies to adapt accordingly.

• Work alongside customers and sales teams in the field to influence customer perceptions and reinforce the value of the brand portfolio.

• Focus on delivering on high-impact opportunities by implementing customer-specific approaches based upon their needs and preferences.

• Demonstrate exceptional awareness of both situational contexts and individual motivations, using this insight to influence stakeholders effectively and drive results.

• Use robust analytical methods to identify issues and opportunities early, integrating new perspectives to refine solutions and strategies.

• Anticipate and eliminate potential obstacles to ensure that teams can focus on delivering impactful results efficiently.

• Lead, coach, and develop Diagnostics Managers and liaisons, defining clear roles, responsibilities and business objectives, and fostering professional growth and engagement.

• Adhere to compliance standards, including the AZ Code of Conduct, Market Policy Handbook, and other regulatory guidelines, ensuring the highest ethical accountability in all professional activities.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Essential: Undergraduate life sciences/medical degree required (advanced degree preferred); Minimum of 5 years of experience in diagnostic or pharmaceuticals; Proven management experience in field; Strong teamwork and collaboration skills; Excellent communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally with market-based and global partners; Ability to identify strategies with the greatest business impact, formulate appropriate business plans, and lead teams to execute them; Demonstrated leadership and communication competencies; Experience in managing budgets; Thorough understanding of customer segments and market dynamics within the diagnostic area; Ability to lead, manage, and develop staff; Previous successful experience in customer support environments; Demonstrated presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Desirable: Proven track record of strategic thinking, judgment, and influencing skills; Demonstrated ability to influence national internal teams and customers to ensure a strong focus with excellent execution; Proven experience in developing compelling business cases; Extensive experience in a launch environment; Strong leadership attributes to set direction, generate commitment, balance short- and long-term needs, and constructively resolve issues; Proven ability to demonstrate effective cross-functional leadership; Advanced Degree PHD,MD or MBA and/or prior experience in multiple functions

Key Relationship to Reach Solutions

  • Internal: Senior management team; Business leaders; Cross functional partners.

  • External: Diagnostic partners; Regulatory bodies.

Date Posted

13-May-2026

Closing Date

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

description:
Typical Accountabilities

• Ensure that Diagnostic Manager and diagnostic liaison objectives are met at a national level by setting clear goals in alignment with organizational priorities.

• Develop a strategy for adoption of companion diagnostic testing, including defining metrics to measure success.

• Identify and build relationships with key scientific stakeholders such as laboratory decision makers, anatomical and molecular pathologists, and other healthcare professionals.

• Provide approved, relevant educational material on diagnostics to enhance understanding and competency among clinical laboratory leaders and their staff.

• Deliver highly technical presentations on data related to diagnostics and testing.

• Educate on the importance of diagnostic quality assurance (QA) programs to ensure high standards in testing processes.

• Partner with diagnostic companies, lab networks, and healthcare professionals to identify and resolve barriers to diagnostic testing, driving accessibility and efficiency.

• Develop tailored strategies that support and educate on appropriate diagnostic testing practices.

• Align actions with broader business plans and assess the impact of external market trends and regulatory changes on organizational strategies to adapt accordingly.

• Work alongside customers and sales teams in the field to influence customer perceptions and reinforce the value of the brand portfolio.

• Focus on delivering on high-impact opportunities by implementing customer-specific approaches based upon their needs and preferences.

• Demonstrate exceptional awareness of both situational contexts and individual motivations, using this insight to influence stakeholders effectively and drive results.

• Use robust analytical methods to identify issues and opportunities early, integrating new perspectives to refine solutions and strategies.

• Anticipate and eliminate potential obstacles to ensure that teams can focus on delivering impactful results efficiently.

• Lead, coach, and develop Diagnostics Managers and liaisons, defining clear roles, responsibilities and business objectives, and fostering professional growth and engagement.

• Adhere to compliance standards, including the AZ Code of Conduct, Market Policy Handbook, and other regulatory guidelines, ensuring the highest ethical accountability in all professional activities.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Essential: Undergraduate life sciences/medical degree required (advanced degree preferred); Minimum of 5 years of experience in diagnostic or pharmaceuticals; Proven management experience in field; Strong teamwork and collaboration skills; Excellent communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally with market-based and global partners; Ability to identify strategies with the greatest business impact, formulate appropriate business plans, and lead teams to execute them; Demonstrated leadership and communication competencies; Experience in managing budgets; Thorough understanding of customer segments and market dynamics within the diagnostic area; Ability to lead, manage, and develop staff; Previous successful experience in customer support environments; Demonstrated presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Desirable: Proven track record of strategic thinking, judgment, and influencing skills; Demonstrated ability to influence national internal teams and customers to ensure a strong focus with excellent execution; Proven experience in developing compelling business cases; Extensive experience in a launch environment; Strong leadership attributes to set direction, generate commitment, balance short- and long-term needs, and constructively resolve issues; Proven ability to demonstrate effective cross-functional leadership; Advanced Degree PHD,MD or MBA and/or prior experience in multiple functions

Key Relationship to Reach Solutions

  • Internal: Senior management team; Business leaders; Cross functional partners.

  • External: Diagnostic partners; Regulatory bodies.

Date Posted

13-May-2026

Closing Date

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX

GCL: D2

Introduction to role

We are looking for a Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX to strengthen our global SAP support and development capability across multiple landscapes and regions. In this role, we combine deep ABAP engineering with thoughtful UX design to transform how thousands of colleagues work every day. We deliver SAP solutions that accelerate critical operations and support the delivery of life-changing medicines to patients across the globe.

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a senior technical authority in a large, global SAP support and development program spanning multiple landscapes and regions. You will design, build and evolve SAP applications that are technically robust and effortless to use—raising adoption, accelerating workflows, and reducing friction at enterprise scale.

Working with architects, product owners and functional experts, you will lead end-to-end solutions across backend and UI—bringing together Fiori/UI5 experiences, OData services and performant ABAP on S/4HANA. You will turn complex processes into clear, accessible screens and flows, guide others to do the same, and drive continuous improvement and stability across our SAP estate.

Accountabilities

  • Fiori/UI5 Engineering: Design, develop and enhance SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 applications, building intuitive, responsive interfaces underpinned by robust OData services.

  • Backend and Integration Leadership: Lead ABAP development for S/4HANA and ECC, including CDS/AMDP and OO ABAP, ensuring clean integration across DRF, IDoc, PI/PO, CPI and SLT.

  • UX Leadership and Adoption: Elevate usability, accessibility and navigation through better screen design, interaction patterns and user flows—driving measurable improvements in adoption and efficiency.

  • Operations: Own incident and problem management, stabilize critical services, and deliver high-quality fixes and improvements across multiple SAP landscapes and time zones.

  • Quality and Documentation: Produce clear technical designs and testing assets; uphold development standards, code quality, and performance tuning for scalability and maintainability.

  • Change and Release Management: Initiate and implement changes tied to SAP Support Packages and Enhancement Packs in partnership with lead consultants; ensure smooth, well-governed deployments.

  • Extensions and Customization: Implement enhancements using BAd Is, user exits and USMD* APIs; configure and test based on functional and technical designs.

  • Performance and Optimization: Proactively identify bottlenecks and optimize applications, workflows and integrations to improve efficiency and reliability.

  • Cross-System Interoperability: Build solutions that perform across a diverse SAP landscape (including ECC 6.0 EHP8, S/4HANA, PI, BW, EWM, GST, GBT, APO, ATTP, MDG, LSCV, SOLMAN, OMP, GST/Movilizer and third-party systems).

  • Embrace AI-enabled and digital development tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality and enhance supportability.

  • Mentoring and Collaboration: Partner with architects and technical leads; mentor peers; promote shared standards and reusable patterns that raise team velocity and consistency.

Crucial Skills/Experience

  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, including user-centered design, usability, responsive design, and accessibility

  • Solid understanding of Fiori/UI5, OData, and front-end-backend integration

  • Strong familiarity with UI and UX fundamentals and enterprise application usability

  • Ability to work with both backend and frontend teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions

  • Integration: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, DRF, IDoc, OData, PI/PO, CPI, SLT

  • Fiori/UI: MDG Fiori apps, OData services, CDS views, UI enhancements, BAd Is

  • Technical Extensions: BAd Is, USMD* APIs, User Exits, BADIs for validations and derivations

  • Programming: ABAP, CDS, OO ABAP, AMDP; performance tuning

  • CORE ABAP (RICEFW) and S/4 HANA (CDS/AMDP/Developer Extensibility)

  • OData API, REST services, ADT Tools (Eclipse), UI5 and Fiori/BAS

  • Modification concepts (Enhancement Framework/BADI/User exits)

  • SAP Integration (API/IDOC/PI-proxy/Files/Other)

  • Conversions (LTMC/BDC)

  • Forms (Adobe Interactive Forms/Smart forms/SAP Scripts)

  • Workflow ABAP

  • RAP

  • Should have completed at least 2 SAP implementations along with support experience.

  • Commit to deliver quality and have a detailed approach

  • Exposure to Run SAP (Solution Manager) methodologies.

  • Superb communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Proactive approach to problem solving.

  • Experience working in a globally distributed team

  • HTML5/Java Script (SAP UI5)

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Good understanding of the Solution Manager CHARM/Jira process will be an added advantage

  • Exposure to BTP Related services and applications

  • Exposure to AI assisted development tools would be preferred (Github Co Pilot, Amazon QDeveloper)

  • BW, ATTP, GBT and APO skills are added Advantage.

  • Preferably an Engineering qualification (B.E / B.Tech) or equivalence.

  • SAP certification on HANA Programming or SAP Net Weaver Development Associate / Professional level.

Why Astra Zeneca

Join a technology community where you are trusted to lead, take ownership and push boundaries in service of a clear purpose: getting medicines to patients faster! Here, unexpected teams come together—engineers, designers and scientists in the same room—turning complex challenges into elegant solutions with data, modern platforms and bold thinking. You will have the space to experiment, from hackathons to large-scale delivery, and the backing to scale what works across a global enterprise. We value kindness alongside ambition, pairing high standards with practical support so you can do the best work of your career while seeing its impact in the real world.

Call to Action

We are seeking a Senior Consultant who can lead robust, user-focused SAP solutions and contribute to meaningful business and patient impact!

Date Posted

29-Jul-2026

Closing Date

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

experienceProfile.rawText: Job Title: Senior Consultant - SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX GCL: D2 Introduction to role We are looking for a Senior Consultant - SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX to strengthen our global SAP support and development capability across multiple landscapes and regions. In this role, we combine deep ABAP engineering with thoughtful UX design to transform how thousands of colleagues work every day. We deliver SAP solutions that accelerate critical operations and support the delivery of life-changing medicines to patients across the globe. As a Senior Consultant, you will be a senior technical authority in a large, global SAP support and development program spanning multiple landscapes and regions. You will design, build and evolve SAP applications that are technically robust and effortless to use-raising adoption, accelerating workflows, and reducing friction at enterprise scale. Working with architects, product owners and functional experts, you will lead end-to-end solutions across backend and UI-bringing together Fiori/UI5 experiences, OData services and performant ABAP on S/4HANA. You will turn complex processes into clear, accessible screens and flows, guide others to do the same, and drive continuous improvement and stability across our SAP estate. Accountabilities Fiori/UI5 Engineering: Design, develop and enhance SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 applications, building intuitive, responsive interfaces underpinned by robust OData services. description:
Job Title: Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX

GCL: D2

Introduction to role

We are looking for a Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA-UI/UX to strengthen our global SAP support and development capability across multiple landscapes and regions. In this role, we combine deep ABAP engineering with thoughtful UX design to transform how thousands of colleagues work every day. We deliver SAP solutions that accelerate critical operations and support the delivery of life-changing medicines to patients across the globe.

As a Senior Consultant, you will be a senior technical authority in a large, global SAP support and development program spanning multiple landscapes and regions. You will design, build and evolve SAP applications that are technically robust and effortless to use—raising adoption, accelerating workflows, and reducing friction at enterprise scale.

Working with architects, product owners and functional experts, you will lead end-to-end solutions across backend and UI—bringing together Fiori/UI5 experiences, OData services and performant ABAP on S/4HANA. You will turn complex processes into clear, accessible screens and flows, guide others to do the same, and drive continuous improvement and stability across our SAP estate.

Accountabilities

  • Fiori/UI5 Engineering: Design, develop and enhance SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 applications, building intuitive, responsive interfaces underpinned by robust OData services.

  • Backend and Integration Leadership: Lead ABAP development for S/4HANA and ECC, including CDS/AMDP and OO ABAP, ensuring clean integration across DRF, IDoc, PI/PO, CPI and SLT.

  • UX Leadership and Adoption: Elevate usability, accessibility and navigation through better screen design, interaction patterns and user flows—driving measurable improvements in adoption and efficiency.

  • Operations: Own incident and problem management, stabilize critical services, and deliver high-quality fixes and improvements across multiple SAP landscapes and time zones.

  • Quality and Documentation: Produce clear technical designs and testing assets; uphold development standards, code quality, and performance tuning for scalability and maintainability.

  • Change and Release Management: Initiate and implement changes tied to SAP Support Packages and Enhancement Packs in partnership with lead consultants; ensure smooth, well-governed deployments.

  • Extensions and Customization: Implement enhancements using BAd Is, user exits and USMD* APIs; configure and test based on functional and technical designs.

  • Performance and Optimization: Proactively identify bottlenecks and optimize applications, workflows and integrations to improve efficiency and reliability.

  • Cross-System Interoperability: Build solutions that perform across a diverse SAP landscape (including ECC 6.0 EHP8, S/4HANA, PI, BW, EWM, GST, GBT, APO, ATTP, MDG, LSCV, SOLMAN, OMP, GST/Movilizer and third-party systems).

  • Embrace AI-enabled and digital development tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality and enhance supportability.

  • Mentoring and Collaboration: Partner with architects and technical leads; mentor peers; promote shared standards and reusable patterns that raise team velocity and consistency.

Crucial Skills/Experience

  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, including user-centered design, usability, responsive design, and accessibility

  • Solid understanding of Fiori/UI5, OData, and front-end-backend integration

  • Strong familiarity with UI and UX fundamentals and enterprise application usability

  • Ability to work with both backend and frontend teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions

  • Integration: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, DRF, IDoc, OData, PI/PO, CPI, SLT

  • Fiori/UI: MDG Fiori apps, OData services, CDS views, UI enhancements, BAd Is

  • Technical Extensions: BAd Is, USMD* APIs, User Exits, BADIs for validations and derivations

  • Programming: ABAP, CDS, OO ABAP, AMDP; performance tuning

  • CORE ABAP (RICEFW) and S/4 HANA (CDS/AMDP/Developer Extensibility)

  • OData API, REST services, ADT Tools (Eclipse), UI5 and Fiori/BAS

  • Modification concepts (Enhancement Framework/BADI/User exits)

  • SAP Integration (API/IDOC/PI-proxy/Files/Other)

  • Conversions (LTMC/BDC)

  • Forms (Adobe Interactive Forms/Smart forms/SAP Scripts)

  • Workflow ABAP

  • RAP

  • Should have completed at least 2 SAP implementations along with support experience.

  • Commit to deliver quality and have a detailed approach

  • Exposure to Run SAP (Solution Manager) methodologies.

  • Superb communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Proactive approach to problem solving.

  • Experience working in a globally distributed team

  • HTML5/Java Script (SAP UI5)

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Good understanding of the Solution Manager CHARM/Jira process will be an added advantage

  • Exposure to BTP Related services and applications

  • Exposure to AI assisted development tools would be preferred (Github Co Pilot, Amazon QDeveloper)

  • BW, ATTP, GBT and APO skills are added Advantage.

  • Preferably an Engineering qualification (B.E / B.Tech) or equivalence.

  • SAP certification on HANA Programming or SAP Net Weaver Development Associate / Professional level.

Why Astra Zeneca

Join a technology community where you are trusted to lead, take ownership and push boundaries in service of a clear purpose: getting medicines to patients faster! Here, unexpected teams come together—engineers, designers and scientists in the same room—turning complex challenges into elegant solutions with data, modern platforms and bold thinking. You will have the space to experiment, from hackathons to large-scale delivery, and the backing to scale what works across a global enterprise. We value kindness alongside ambition, pairing high standards with practical support so you can do the best work of your career while seeing its impact in the real world.

Call to Action

We are seeking a Senior Consultant who can lead robust, user-focused SAP solutions and contribute to meaningful business and patient impact!

Date Posted

29-Jul-2026

Closing Date

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA

GCL: D1

Introduction to ROLE:

We are looking for a Senior Consultant with deep SAP ABAP on HANA and MDG expertise to help keep a complex global enterprise running at peak performance and support medicines reaching patients faster. This role sits at the heart of our digital transformation, where robust engineering and rapid problem solving keep critical processes flowing across continents.

You will join a senior technical team leading development, maintenance and new capability delivery across multiple SAP landscapes. From safeguarding master data quality to optimising performance in S/4HANA and ECC, your decisions will directly influence how efficiently we discover, make and supply life-changing medicines. We value people who can identify bottlenecks quickly, deliver scalable fixes and drive meaningful impact across our global enterprise!

Accountabilities:

  • Application Ownership and Reliability: Lead incident and problem management for complex SAP landscapes, restoring service quickly and preventing recurrence to protect business continuity.

  • Design and Development Leadership: Translate Functional and Technical Designs into robust build plans; author Technical Design and Testing documents that guide quality delivery.

  • MDG Engineering and Governance: Design and extend MDG data models, workflows and BRF+ logic; enforce data standards and replication patterns to keep master data accurate and trusted.

  • S/4HANA and Core ABAP Delivery: Build high‑performance RICEFW objects using ABAP, OO ABAP, CDS, AMDP and RAP; expose services via OData and REST to power modern UIs and integrations.

  • Integration at Scale: Engineer and maintain interfaces across S/4HANA, ECC and third‑party systems using DRF, IDoc, PI/PO, CPI, SLT and APIs; ensure resilient, observable data flows.

  • Quality Engineering and Testing: Define and complete unit, integration and regression testing; automate where possible to increase coverage and speed without sacrificing quality.

  • Release and Lifecycle Management: Prepare and deliver Support Packages and Enhancement Packs with Architects and Lead Consultants; handle changes via Solution Manager/Cha RM processes.

  • Performance and Optimization: Profile, tune and refactor code and data models to improve efficiency and stability; establish proactive measurements and dashboards for early warning.

  • Collaboration and Influence: Partner with Architects, Functional Leads and global teams; provide mentorship, code reviews and guidance that raise the engineering bar.

  • Continuous Improvement and Tooling: Identify and drive enhancements across ECC 6.0 EHP8, S/4HANA, PI, BW, EWM, GST, GBT, APO, ATTP, MDG, LSCV, SOLMAN, OMP, GST/Movilizer and third‑party systems; embrace AI‑enabled and digital tools in day‑to‑day work to improve outcomes and ways of working.

Crucial Skills/Experience:

  • SAP MDG: Data Modeling (MM, BP, FI), UI Modeling (FPM/MDC), Rule-based Workflows, BRF+, Derivations/Validations, Data Replication (SOA/ALE), DRF

  • MDG Domains: BP (Customer/Vendor), Material, Finance (GL/Cost Center/Profit Center)

  • Integration: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, DRF, IDoc, OData, PI/PO, CPI, SLT

  • Fiori/UI: MDG Fiori apps, OData services, CDS views, UI enhancements, BAd Is

  • Data Quality & Governance: Duplicate checks, Match & Merge, Validation frameworks, Data enrichment, Consolidation

  • Workflow & BRF+: Rule modeling, Determinations, Approval workflows, Notifications

  • Technical Extensions: BAd Is, USMD* APIs, User Exits, BADIs for validations and derivations

  • Programming: ABAP, CDS, OO ABAP, AMDP; performance tuning

  • Migration: MDG Consolidation, MDG Mass Processing, LSMW/SLT, ETL coordination

  • CORE ABAP (RICEFW) and S/4 HANA (CDS/AMDP/Developer Extensibility)

  • OData API, REST services, ADT Tools (Eclipse), UI5 and Fiori/BAS

  • Modification concepts (Enhancement Framework/BADI/User exits)

  • SAP Integration (API/IDOC/PI-proxy/Files/Other)

  • Conversions (LTMC/BDC)

  • Forms (Adobe Interactive Forms/Smart forms/SAP Scripts)

  • Workflow ABAP

  • RAP

  • HTML5/Java Script (SAP UI5)

  • Should have completed at least 2 SAP implementations along with support experience.

  • Commit to deliver quality and have a thorough approach.

  • Exposure to Run SAP (Solution Manager) methodologies.

  • Superb communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Proactive approach to problem solving.

  • Experience working in a globally distributed team.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Good understanding of the Solution Manager CHARM/Jira process.

  • BW, ATTP, GBT and APO skills.

  • Preferably an Engineering qualification (B.E / B.Tech) or equivalence.

  • Exposure to AI assisted development tools would be preferred

  • SAP certification on HANA Programming or SAP Net Weaver Development Associate / Professional level.

Why Astra Zeneca:

Join a global technology community where your engineering helps unlock science and gets medicines to patients sooner. We combine bold science with advanced platforms, bringing unexpected teams into the same room to spark new ideas and ship at scale. You will have the autonomy to experiment with leading tools, the support to learn continuously, and the opportunity to see your code ripple across manufacturing, supply and finance. We value kindness alongside ambition, and we champion practical innovation that simplifies, speeds up and sustains how we work—so every improvement you deliver makes a tangible difference beyond our walls.

Call to Action:

If you are ready to lead with code, elevate data quality at scale and turn complex SAP landscapes into a competitive advantage, step forward and help us deliver life‑changing impact faster!

description:
Job Title: Senior Consultant – SAP ABAP HANA

GCL: D1

Introduction to ROLE:

We are looking for a Senior Consultant with deep SAP ABAP on HANA and MDG expertise to help keep a complex global enterprise running at peak performance and support medicines reaching patients faster. This role sits at the heart of our digital transformation, where robust engineering and rapid problem solving keep critical processes flowing across continents.

You will join a senior technical team leading development, maintenance and new capability delivery across multiple SAP landscapes. From safeguarding master data quality to optimising performance in S/4HANA and ECC, your decisions will directly influence how efficiently we discover, make and supply life-changing medicines. We value people who can identify bottlenecks quickly, deliver scalable fixes and drive meaningful impact across our global enterprise!

Accountabilities:

  • Application Ownership and Reliability: Lead incident and problem management for complex SAP landscapes, restoring service quickly and preventing recurrence to protect business continuity.

  • Design and Development Leadership: Translate Functional and Technical Designs into robust build plans; author Technical Design and Testing documents that guide quality delivery.

  • MDG Engineering and Governance: Design and extend MDG data models, workflows and BRF+ logic; enforce data standards and replication patterns to keep master data accurate and trusted.

  • S/4HANA and Core ABAP Delivery: Build high‑performance RICEFW objects using ABAP, OO ABAP, CDS, AMDP and RAP; expose services via OData and REST to power modern UIs and integrations.

  • Integration at Scale: Engineer and maintain interfaces across S/4HANA, ECC and third‑party systems using DRF, IDoc, PI/PO, CPI, SLT and APIs; ensure resilient, observable data flows.

  • Quality Engineering and Testing: Define and complete unit, integration and regression testing; automate where possible to increase coverage and speed without sacrificing quality.

  • Release and Lifecycle Management: Prepare and deliver Support Packages and Enhancement Packs with Architects and Lead Consultants; handle changes via Solution Manager/Cha RM processes.

  • Performance and Optimization: Profile, tune and refactor code and data models to improve efficiency and stability; establish proactive measurements and dashboards for early warning.

  • Collaboration and Influence: Partner with Architects, Functional Leads and global teams; provide mentorship, code reviews and guidance that raise the engineering bar.

  • Continuous Improvement and Tooling: Identify and drive enhancements across ECC 6.0 EHP8, S/4HANA, PI, BW, EWM, GST, GBT, APO, ATTP, MDG, LSCV, SOLMAN, OMP, GST/Movilizer and third‑party systems; embrace AI‑enabled and digital tools in day‑to‑day work to improve outcomes and ways of working.

Crucial Skills/Experience:

  • SAP MDG: Data Modeling (MM, BP, FI), UI Modeling (FPM/MDC), Rule-based Workflows, BRF+, Derivations/Validations, Data Replication (SOA/ALE), DRF

  • MDG Domains: BP (Customer/Vendor), Material, Finance (GL/Cost Center/Profit Center)

  • Integration: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, DRF, IDoc, OData, PI/PO, CPI, SLT

  • Fiori/UI: MDG Fiori apps, OData services, CDS views, UI enhancements, BAd Is

  • Data Quality & Governance: Duplicate checks, Match & Merge, Validation frameworks, Data enrichment, Consolidation

  • Workflow & BRF+: Rule modeling, Determinations, Approval workflows, Notifications

  • Technical Extensions: BAd Is, USMD* APIs, User Exits, BADIs for validations and derivations

  • Programming: ABAP, CDS, OO ABAP, AMDP; performance tuning

  • Migration: MDG Consolidation, MDG Mass Processing, LSMW/SLT, ETL coordination

  • CORE ABAP (RICEFW) and S/4 HANA (CDS/AMDP/Developer Extensibility)

  • OData API, REST services, ADT Tools (Eclipse), UI5 and Fiori/BAS

  • Modification concepts (Enhancement Framework/BADI/User exits)

  • SAP Integration (API/IDOC/PI-proxy/Files/Other)

  • Conversions (LTMC/BDC)

  • Forms (Adobe Interactive Forms/Smart forms/SAP Scripts)

  • Workflow ABAP

  • RAP

  • HTML5/Java Script (SAP UI5)

  • Should have completed at least 2 SAP implementations along with support experience.

  • Commit to deliver quality and have a thorough approach.

  • Exposure to Run SAP (Solution Manager) methodologies.

  • Superb communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Proactive approach to problem solving.

  • Experience working in a globally distributed team.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Good understanding of the Solution Manager CHARM/Jira process.

title: Associate Director - Category Supply Planner
jobDescription:
Job Title: Associate Director-Category supply planner

GCL : E

Introduction to role

Are you ready to orchestrate critical materials across a global network so life-changing medicines reach patients without interruption? Do you see yourself turning capacity constraints into resilient plans that keep service high and inventories optimized? This role sits above site, crafting how materials flow across multiple brands and suppliers, and ensuring our complex pipeline moves from molecule to medicine at pace.

You will lead materials planning for a sophisticated, high-impact category across a 3–24 month horizon, balancing global demand and supply while driving visibility, resilience, and performance. Working across internal manufacturing sites and external partners, you will deploy core planning processes, lead consensus forums, and turn data into clear decisions that safeguard our network. Your leadership will directly protect patient service, optimize working capital, and enable new products to scale.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure supply is secured in a 3 to 24 month timeframe. Optimize inventory and align with 0–13 week site plans to meet customer service levels.
  • Integrated Planning Deployment: Partner with global planning and internal sites to implement inventory design, forecasting, visibility, capacity planning, and scenario planning that drive network-wide decisions.
  • Critical Materials Consensus: Lead the materials supply consensus in line with the planning calendar, resolve exceptions, bring up risks, and ensure site plans reflect agreed solutions.
  • Network Issue Resolution: Lead resolution of supply or capacity issues at suppliers impacting multiple sites and brands; align with network planning to define scenarios for decision-making.
  • Global MRP and Capacity Forecast: Lead all aspects of worldwide materials needs and capacity projection for essential suppliers to direct supply commitments and risk posture.
  • Supplier and Site Collaboration: Work closely with critical suppliers and supply sites to maintain robust material flow, collate OTIF data, and set appropriate safety stocks for high-risk materials.
  • Supplier Performance Governance: Run a strong supplier performance cadence with weekly and monthly reviews to drive accountability and improvement.
  • Business Continuity: Understand and apply business continuity strategies; implement actions to protect supply of critical materials.
  • Network Engagement: Build strong links with the site planning community; lead regular supply and demand discussions to capture market and brand dynamics and reflect them in site forecasts and supplier S&OP.
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation: Collaborate with external operations leaders to contribute to supplier IRM, documenting risks and driving mitigations with suppliers and sites.
  • Constraint Management and Allocation: In constraint situations, develop network scenarios, secure endorsement from external supply leadership, and oversee execution of supply solutions and allocation across the network.
  • Inventory and MRP Optimization: Improve MRP parameters (lead times, safety stocks, consumption patterns); monitor signals, evaluate orders and due dates, and maintain healthy inventory positions.
  • Data and Process Improvement: Elevate materials planning processes, data quality, and MRP system performance to enable faster, better decisions.
  • Projects and Continuous Improvement: Participate in internal and supplier projects, applying Lean tools to simplify and standardize.
  • Cross-Site Influence: Collaborate across sites to manage shared critical materials and lead allocation in coordination with external operations and supply leadership.
  • Coaching and SME Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert and coach junior team members to elevate capability across the network.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • A degree or equivalent in Business, Logistics, Sciences or Engineering is preferred; equivalent experience will be taken into account.
  • 10+ years of prior experience in Supply Chain Environment (Manufacturing, Planning, & Procurement).
  • Proficient in complex supply chain planning encompassing inventory, capacity, and network aspects.
  • Capacity management & modelling.
  • Strong process improvement expertise and operational experience with ERP/APS systems.
  • Understanding of supply chain planning parameters, master data and master data integrity & quality is a must.
  • Strong competence in supplier contract T&C, SLA (Service Level Agreement), and MSA (Master Supply Agreement).
  • Experience in managing and developing solutions for supply chain events is needed.
  • Proven leadership and influencing skills in a cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in collaboration with key interfaces within the end-to-end supply chain, with manufacturing, supply chain, procurement and commercial functions – experience working with third-party suppliers.
  • Digital savvy (data & system minded), proficient in using key Lean tools, and excellent communication and collaboration skills to manage a broad range of internal and external partners.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Robust understanding of and contributing to an S&OP process.
  • Sophisticated supply chain (capacity and inventory) planning skills.
  • APICS/CSCP or equivalent certification.
  • Lean certification.
  • Leadership experience.

Why Astra Zeneca

Here you will connect bold science with disciplined execution to make a tangible difference for patients. We bring unexpected teams into the same room to spark new solutions, combining modern digital tools, Lean ways of working, and real-time data to run an agile, global supply network. You will gain hands-on influence across a complex pipeline, with opportunities to lead, learn, and experiment as we scale new modalities and smarter factories. We value kindness alongside ambition, blend in-person collaboration with flexibility, and back our people with investment in technology and capability building—while driving a sustainability agenda that pushes toward zero carbon operations and a carbon-negative value chain. Your decisions will directly shape how quickly and reliably medicines reach those who need them most.

Call to Action

Step forward to lead critical materials planning at global scale—take ownership of this opportunity and help us deliver more medicines to patients, faster!

Date Posted

29-Jul-2026

Closing Date

11-Aug-2026

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

description:
Job Title: Associate Director-Category supply planner

GCL : E

Introduction to role

Are you ready to orchestrate critical materials across a global network so life-changing medicines reach patients without interruption? Do you see yourself turning capacity constraints into resilient plans that keep service high and inventories optimized? This role sits above site, crafting how materials flow across multiple brands and suppliers, and ensuring our complex pipeline moves from molecule to medicine at pace.

You will lead materials planning for a sophisticated, high-impact category across a 3–24 month horizon, balancing global demand and supply while driving visibility, resilience, and performance. Working across internal manufacturing sites and external partners, you will deploy core planning processes, lead consensus forums, and turn data into clear decisions that safeguard our network. Your leadership will directly protect patient service, optimize working capital, and enable new products to scale.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure supply is secured in a 3 to 24 month timeframe. Optimize inventory and align with 0–13 week site plans to meet customer service levels.
  • Integrated Planning Deployment: Partner with global planning and internal sites to implement inventory design, forecasting, visibility, capacity planning, and scenario planning that drive network-wide decisions.
  • Critical Materials Consensus: Lead the materials supply consensus in line with the planning calendar, resolve exceptions, bring up risks, and ensure site plans reflect agreed solutions.
  • Network Issue Resolution: Lead resolution of supply or capacity issues at suppliers impacting multiple sites and brands; align with network planning to define scenarios for decision-making.
  • Global MRP and Capacity Forecast: Lead all aspects of worldwide materials needs and capacity projection for essential suppliers to direct supply commitments and risk posture.
  • Supplier and Site Collaboration: Work closely with critical suppliers and supply sites to maintain robust material flow, collate OTIF data, and set appropriate safety stocks for high-risk materials.
  • Supplier Performance Governance: Run a strong supplier performance cadence with weekly and monthly reviews to drive accountability and improvement.
  • Business Continuity: Understand and apply business continuity strategies; implement actions to protect supply of critical materials.
  • Network Engagement: Build strong links with the site planning community; lead regular supply and demand discussions to capture market and brand dynamics and reflect them in site forecasts and supplier S&OP.
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation: Collaborate with external operations leaders to contribute to supplier IRM, documenting risks and driving mitigations with suppliers and sites.
  • Constraint Management and Allocation: In constraint situations, develop network scenarios, secure endorsement from external supply leadership, and oversee execution of supply solutions and allocation across the network.
  • Inventory and MRP Optimization: Improve MRP parameters (lead times, safety stocks, consumption patterns); monitor signals, evaluate orders and due dates, and maintain healthy inventory positions.
  • Data and Process Improvement: Elevate materials planning processes, data quality, and MRP system performance to enable faster, better decisions.
  • Projects and Continuous Improvement: Participate in internal and supplier projects, applying Lean tools to simplify and standardize.
  • Cross-Site Influence: Collaborate across sites to manage shared critical materials and lead allocation in coordination with external operations and supply leadership.
  • Coaching and SME Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert and coach junior team members to elevate capability across the network.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • A degree or equivalent in Business, Logistics, Sciences or Engineering is preferred; equivalent experience will be taken into account.
  • 10+ years of prior experience in Supply Chain Environment (Manufacturing, Planning, & Procurement).
  • Proficient in complex supply chain planning encompassing inventory, capacity, and network aspects.
  • Capacity management & modelling.
  • Strong process improvement expertise and operational experience with ERP/APS systems.
  • Understanding of supply chain planning parameters, master data and master data integrity & quality is a must.
  • Strong competence in supplier contract T&C, SLA (Service Level Agreement), and MSA (Master Supply Agreement).
  • Experience in managing and developing solutions for supply chain events is needed.
  • Proven leadership and influencing skills in a cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in collaboration with key interfaces within the end-to-end supply chain, with manufacturing, supply chain, procurement and commercial functions – experience working with third-party suppliers.
  • Digital savvy (data & system minded), proficient in using key Lean tools, and excellent communication and collaboration skills to manage a broad range of internal and external partners.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Robust understanding of and contributing to an S&OP process.
  • Sophisticated supply chain (capacity and inventory) planning skills.
  • APICS/CSCP or equivalent certification.
  • Lean certification.
  • Leadership experience.

Why Astra Zeneca

Here you will connect bold science with disciplined execution to make a tangible difference for patients. We bring unexpected teams into the same room to spark new solutions, combining modern digital tools, Lean ways of working, and real-time data to run an agile, global supply network. You will gain hands-on influence across a complex pipeline, with opportunities to lead, learn, and experiment as we scale new modalities and smarter factories. We value kindness alongside ambition, blend in-person collaboration with flexibility, and back our people with investment in technology and capability building—while driving a sustainability agenda that pushes toward zero carbon operations and a carbon-negative value chain. Your decisions will directly shape how quickly and reliably medicines reach those who need them most.

Call to Action

Step forward to lead critical materials planning at global scale—take ownership of this opportunity and help us deliver more medicines to patients, faster!

Date Posted

29-Jul-2026

Closing Date

11-Aug-2026

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: IT Senior Business Analyst
jobDescription:
Introduction to ROLE:

Are you ready to turn complex business needs into clear, result technology outcomes that help bring vital medicines to patients faster? Do you flourish with translating ambiguity into critical action while partnering across business and IT to unlock measurable value?

In this role, you will be a central connector between diverse partners and technical groups, crafting the requirements that drive high-impact solutions across our global enterprise. You will help set analysis approaches, ensure traceability from ideas to benefits, and influence decisions that modernize how we operate. Your work will power smarter ways of working today while laying the foundations for tomorrow’s growth.

Accountabilities:

Analysis Strategy and Planning: Define the right analysis approach for each initiative, balancing complexity, risk, and dependencies. Scope work optimally and lead your plan to deliver to deadlines without losing sight of value.

Stakeholder Engagement and Influence: Identify and engage collaborators at all levels. Build trust-based relationships, tailor communication to influence outcomes, and chip in to plans that drive informed decisions and adoption.

Requirements Leadership: Lead end-to-end requirements management from discovery to validation. Translate business objectives into clear functional and technical requirements, ensuring robust traceability and alignment with Functional Build, User Interface Compose, and Business Process Develop.

Architecture Partnership: Work closely with architecture and engineering teams to assure that the proposed technical solution delivers the agreed business benefits, adheres to standards, and scales for future needs.

Solution Assessment and Value Focus: Evaluate solution options, challenge assumptions, and articulate the reasoning behind recommendations. Assess business readiness and guide teams to improve value versus spend.

Business Case and Benefits Realization: Support the creation of cases, collecting justification including return on investment and benefits measures. Track value realization through delivery and into operation.

Apply AI-assisted techniques to speed up discovery and documentation. Use LLMs to coordinate and prioritize ambiguous inputs and identify business rules from interviews. Improve the consistency and completeness of documentation related to requirements.

Change and Communications: Chip in to change plans and communication strategies to ensure alignment, understanding, and adoption across functions and geographies.

Governance and Compliance: Operate effectively within regulated environments, ensuring requirements and testing practices meet compliance needs and stand up to audit.

Collaboration and Coaching: Partner with IT leaders, service managers, and multi-functional project teams. Share standard processes and support team development to improve on analysis quality.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Experience of using business analysis tools/techniques to design and deliver business change
  • Strong engagement, communication and facilitation skills, including presentation and influencing skills
  • Demonstrated involvement in a regulated environment
  • Background in collaborating with third party suppliers/vendor

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Degree in a relevant subject area or formal certification in business analysis practice
  • Exposure to Agile methodology and familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall delivery models
  • Experience of working in a global organisation
  • Pharmaceutical business awareness/business domain knowledge
  • Excellent documentation skills and proficiency with MS Visio
  • Hands-on experience producing Business Requirements Documents (BRD or equivalent experience), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS), Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTM), and handling product backlogs
  • Experience collaborating with external consultants and vendors, with strong written and oral communication
  • Background working with pharma clients and understanding of regulated processes
  • Experience employing LLMs and AI assistants to analyze interview transcripts, extract business rules, and translate findings into functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Applied AI-enhanced requirements engineering and prompt engineering to accelerate documentation and improve quality and consistency of requirement artifacts

Why Astra Zeneca:

Join a high-performing, collaborative team that sits at the heart of how our business runs, where bright minds and practical problem solvers bring technology and operations together to deliver for patients. You will work on intellectually stimulating, complex challenges that require creativity, rigor, and pace—often with engineers, architects, and business leaders in the same room, turning ideas into outcomes. We champion digital innovation, thoughtful risk-taking, and data-driven decisions, and we value understanding alongside ambition.

Call to Action:

Make your next move count—bring your analysis leadership to a place where your work accelerates science and creates real-world impact today!

Date Posted

31-Jul-2026

Closing Date

13-Aug-2026

Astra Zeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

experienceProfile.rawText: Introduction to ROLE: Are you ready to turn complex business needs into clear, result technology outcomes that help bring vital medicines to patients faster? Do you flourish with translating ambiguity into critical action while partnering across business and IT to unlock measurable value? In this role, you will be a central connector between diverse partners and technical groups, crafting the requirements that drive high-impact solutions across our global enterprise. You will help set analysis approaches, ensure traceability from ideas to benefits, and influence decisions that modernize how we operate. Your work will power smarter ways of working today while laying the foundations for tomorrow's growth. Accountabilities: Analysis Strategy and Planning: Define the right analysis approach for each initiative, balancing complexity, risk, and dependencies. Scope work optimally and lead your plan to deliver to deadlines without losing sight of value. Stakeholder Engagement and Influence: Identify and engage collaborators at all levels. Build trust-based relationships, tailor communication to influence outcomes, and chip in to plans that drive informed decisions and adoption. Requirements Leadership: Lead end-to-end requirements management from discovery to validation. Translate business objectives into clear functional and technical requirements, ensuring robust traceability and alignment with Functional Build, User Interface Compose, and Business Process Develop. Architecture Partnership: Work closely with architecture and engineering teams to assure that the proposed technical solution delivers the agreed business benefits, adheres to standards, and scales for future needs. Solution Assessment and Value Focus: Evaluate solution options, challenge assumptions, and articulate the reasoning behind recommendations. Assess business readiness and guide teams to improve value versus spend. Business Case and Benefits Realization: Support the creation of cases, collecting justification including return on investment and benefits measures. Track value realization through delivery and into operation. Apply AI-assisted techniques to speed up discovery and documentation. Use LLMs to coordinate and prioritize ambiguous inputs and identify business rules from interviews. Improve the consistency and completeness of documentation related to requirements. Change and Communications: Chip in to change plans and communication strategies to ensure alignment, understanding, and adoption across functions and geographies. description:
Introduction to ROLE:

Are you ready to turn complex business needs into clear, result technology outcomes that help bring vital medicines to patients faster? Do you flourish with translating ambiguity into critical action while partnering across business and IT to unlock measurable value?

In this role, you will be a central connector between diverse partners and technical groups, crafting the requirements that drive high-impact solutions across our global enterprise. You will help set analysis approaches, ensure traceability from ideas to benefits, and influence decisions that modernize how we operate. Your work will power smarter ways of working today while laying the foundations for tomorrow’s growth.

Accountabilities:

Analysis Strategy and Planning: Define the right analysis approach for each initiative, balancing complexity, risk, and dependencies. Scope work optimally and lead your plan to deliver to deadlines without losing sight of value.

Stakeholder Engagement and Influence: Identify and engage collaborators at all levels. Build trust-based relationships, tailor communication to influence outcomes, and chip in to plans that drive informed decisions and adoption.

Requirements Leadership: Lead end-to-end requirements management from discovery to validation. Translate business objectives into clear functional and technical requirements, ensuring robust traceability and alignment with Functional Build, User Interface Compose, and Business Process Develop.

Architecture Partnership: Work closely with architecture and engineering teams to assure that the proposed technical solution delivers the agreed business benefits, adheres to standards, and scales for future needs.

Solution Assessment and Value Focus: Evaluate solution options, challenge assumptions, and articulate the reasoning behind recommendations. Assess business readiness and guide teams to improve value versus spend.

Business Case and Benefits Realization: Support the creation of cases, collecting justification including return on investment and benefits measures. Track value realization through delivery and into operation.

Apply AI-assisted techniques to speed up discovery and documentation. Use LLMs to coordinate and prioritize ambiguous inputs and identify business rules from interviews. Improve the consistency and completeness of documentation related to requirements.

Change and Communications: Chip in to change plans and communication strategies to ensure alignment, understanding, and adoption across functions and geographies.

Governance and Compliance: Operate effectively within regulated environments, ensuring requirements and testing practices meet compliance needs and stand up to audit.

Collaboration and Coaching: Partner with IT leaders, service managers, and multi-functional project teams. Share standard processes and support team development to improve on analysis quality.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Experience of using business analysis tools/techniques to design and deliver business change
  • Strong engagement, communication and facilitation skills, including presentation and influencing skills
  • Demonstrated involvement in a regulated environment
  • Background in collaborating with third party suppliers/vendor

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Degree in a relevant subject area or formal certification in business analysis practice
  • Exposure to Agile methodology and familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall delivery models
  • Experience of working in a global organisation
  • Pharmaceutical business awareness/business domain knowledge
  • Excellent documentation skills and proficiency with MS Visio
  • Hands-on experience producing Business Requirements Documents (BRD or equivalent experience), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS), Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTM), and handling product backlogs
  • Experience collaborating with external consultants and vendors, with strong written and oral communication
  • Background working with pharma clients and understanding of regulated processes
  • Experience employing LLMs and AI assistants to analyze interview transcripts, extract business rules, and translate findings into functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Applied AI-enhanced requirements engineering and prompt engineering to accelerate documentation and improve quality and consistency of requirement artifacts

Why Astra Zeneca:

Join a high-performing, collaborative team that sits at the heart of how our business runs, where bright minds and practical problem solvers bring technology and operations together to deliver for patients. You will work on intellectually stimulating, complex challenges that require creativity, rigor, and pace—often with engineers, architects, and business leaders in the same room, turning ideas into outcomes. We champion digital innovation, thoughtful risk-taking, and data-driven decisions, and we value understanding alongside ambition.

Call to Action:

Make your next move count—bring your analysis leadership to a place where your work accelerates science and creates real-world impact today!
